subject: open Gemma family chronology
observation: No distinct successor to Gemma 4 was found in the official release log, current Google Gemma collection, and August Google ecosystem posts inspected. This is bounded to sources checked.

subject: Gemma 4 MTP assistant checkpoints
observation: Google released open Apache-2.0 speculative drafters that consume target activations and share its KV cache. Public hardware claims do not establish Proxima acceleration.
source_locator: How speculative decoding works; Where you can dive deeper; Get started

subject: Gemma 4 QAT checkpoints
observation: Google supplies checkpoints trained to preserve quality under quantization, including Q4_0 and mobile formats. The local Gemma pilot uses the existing E2B QAT checkpoint; no QAT-versus-PTQ comparison was run.
source_locator: Keeping model quality while making them smaller; Get started today

subject: DiffusionGemma
observation: Google supplies an Apache-2.0 experimental MoE checkpoint with bidirectional block generation and iterative refinement. Google reports lower output quality than standard Gemma 4 and says Apple Silicon may not see the same acceleration as dedicated GPUs.
source_locator: Unlocking new value for developers; Get started today
integration_gap: diffusion runtime and checkpoint weights absent

subject: Granite 1B-A400M identity

subject: performance lab implementation language
observation: Owner prohibits every form of Python, Perl, Bash or other script. Experiment orchestration is a compiled Rust example using the existing generation CLI and raw payload records.

subject: default ngram configuration on the initial bounded pilot
observation: The first campaign retained matching OFF/ON payloads but emitted no request-level draft counters. The inspected ngram-simple implementation returns before lookup when history length is at most size_n + size_m + 1. Its default settings exceed the history available in this pilot. The negative campaign is preserved; the next campaign fixes both arms to a smaller configuration to exercise drafting without changing the algorithm.

subject: explicit ngram 3/3 pilot
observation: Every recorded pair retained identical generated IDs and text; no positive request draft counter was recorded. No timing difference is attributed to speculation. For the period-three Gemma payload, the newest three-token match leaves two continuation tokens, rejected by copy_max < size_n at proxima-tokenizer/src/draft/ngram_simple.rs:175. Resolved-settings telemetry and the 1/3 experiment recorded separately check this configuration path.
